opportunities.name: Look up a GitHub user profile
opportunities.description: Search GitHub for a {person} name or handle, switch the results to the Users tab, and open that person's profile.
steps: Click the GitHub search box in the header
Type the person's name or handle and press Enter
Click the 'Users' filter in the left sidebar
Click the matching user in the results
Look over the profile (bio, followers, pinned repos)

opportunities.name: Fill in and discard a new message draft
opportunities.description: Open the New message form, fill in To, Subject and Body with {recipient}, {subject} and {body}, then click Discard.
opportunities.site: local mail compose page (New message form)
steps: Open the New message compose page
Click the To field and enter the recipient
Click the Subject field and enter the subject
Click the Body field and enter the message text

opportunities.name: View a Wayback Machine snapshot of a site for a given year
opportunities.description: Enter {url} in the Wayback Machine, choose {year} on the calendar, open a capture from that year, and browse the archived page.
steps: Click the Wayback Machine URL box and enter the site URL
Click the year in the timeline bar
Click a highlighted date in the calendar to open the snapshot
Browse the archived page (or type another URL in the Wayback toolbar)
Retry if you get a 429 rate-limit error
